newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania state budget deficit soars in October.
newsitem.headline: Romania state budget deficit soars in October.

text.p: Romania's state budget deficit ballooned in October to 3.66 trillion lei for the January- October period from 2.86 trillion lei in the first nine months of this year, official data showed on Thursday.

Ten-month expenditure amounted to 17.87 trillion lei, up from 15.41 trillion at end-September. Revenues rose to 14.2 trillion lei over January-October from 12.55 trillion in the first nine months this year.
Relaxed budgetary policy in an election campaign triggered a soaring public deficit estimated at some 5.0 percent of gross domestic product, against an IMF-agreed target of 2.2 percent.
The International Monetary Fund suspended loan tranches for Romania this year over foreign exchange market restrictions and on slow reforms and lax budgetary discipline.
The IMF chief negotiator for Romania, Poul Thomsen, said this week the Fund was likely to resume talks on credits in the New Year, after an evaluation of the economy is completed.
Thomsen said the new government should tackle the budget deficit problem and consider carefully further spending.
The budget deficit was revised twice this year. Last month the outgoing government put it at a forecast 4.46 trillion lei for the whole year against a previous 4.27 trillion.
